title: Marketing Manager
description:
Digital Marketing Manager

Location: Bristol

Salary: £45,000 + Benefits

The Opportunity

An established and rapidly expanding international business is seeking a commercially minded Digital Commerce Marketing Manager to take ownership of its online customer proposition and support the continued growth of its portfolio of brands.

Working closely with senior marketing leadership, you will be responsible for managing the day-to-day performance of the group's digital commerce activity, combining commercial insight, campaign management, customer communications and data analysis to maximise online revenue and engagement.

The position would suit a proactive marketing professional who enjoys working across multiple brands and channels and is keen to take ownership of projects within a fast-paced and developing environment.

Key Areas of Responsibility
- Develop and deliver digital acquisition and promotional initiatives designed to improve online revenue, profitability and customer engagement.
- Take ownership of the commercial performance and ongoing development of multiple direct-to-consumer websites.
- Review trading information, customer behaviour and website metrics to identify opportunities for growth.
- Plan and coordinate digital activity alongside wider commercial and sales initiatives.
- Manage the production and delivery of marketing content across relevant digital and customer-facing channels.
- Evaluate campaign results and provide clear performance reporting against agreed objectives.
- Work with external creative, digital and marketing partners, ensuring activity is delivered efficiently, on time and in line with business objectives.
- Maintain and develop customer databases and targeted communication lists.
- Produce regular management reports covering digital performance, campaign activity, website traffic and commercial results.
- Lead the delivery of customer-facing communications, including email marketing, promotional campaigns and supporting marketing materials.
- Work collaboratively with sales teams to develop targeted promotions, offers and dedicated landing pages designed to improve conversion and customer experience.
- Ensure customer data is accurately maintained and managed in accordance with applicable GDPR requirements.
- Analyse consumer sales performance and market trends to support future commercial and marketing planning.
- Monitor digital expenditure and campaign effectiveness, using performance data and emerging trends to identify opportunities for optimisation.
- Use customer and website insight to develop innovative approaches to acquisition, retention and online growth.

What We're Looking For
- Proven experience in a digital marketing, e-commerce or online trading environment.
- Strong commercial understanding of consumer-focused e-commerce.
- Demonstrable experience working with sales and performance data to identify trends and opportunities.
- Practical experience using Google Analytics or comparable digital analytics platforms.
- A strong understanding of digital customer journeys, online conversion and campaign performance.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- Strong project coordination and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
- A creative and commercially aware approach to developing marketing activity.
- Ideally, a recognised qualification in Marketing, Digital Marketing or a related discipline.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work effectively to demanding deadlines.
- A confident, energetic and solutions-focused approach, with the initiative to take ownership and drive activity forward.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing international organisation where digital commerce is an important part of its continued expansion. You will have the opportunity to work across multiple brands and markets, influence online growth initiatives and develop your career within a business that offers genuine scope for progression.

title: SEO Manager
description:
We're working with an exciting, fast-growing start-up agency that has built a strong position in its market over the last two years. With a young and ambitious team behind it, this is an opportunity to join at an important stage of growth and play a key role in shaping how SEO develops.

As SEO Manager, you'll own SEO across the full client base. You'll create strategies, manage priorities and set the quality bar for SEO delivery. You'll work closely with content writers and implementers, while also getting involved in technical SEO, Local SEO, reporting and the emerging world of AI search.

What you'll be doing
You'll own the SEO strategy across a portfolio of clients, using data from Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush, Rankability and site crawls to identify opportunities and build clear six-week action plans. You'll manage around 60 tasks within each sprint, making sure priorities are clear and work is delivered to a high standard. You'll review published work and maintain the overall quality of SEO output.

You'll also oversee Local SEO at scale, including Google Business Profiles, citations and location pages. AI search visibility will be another important part of the role, with responsibility for tracking how clients are appearing across emerging search experiences.

Alongside the delivery side, you'll help develop reporting and dashboards, work with the content and implementation team, and provide guidance and mentoring to support their development.

What experience you'll need to apply
- Solid agency side experience managing SEO strategies across multiple websites or clients.
- Strong technical SEO knowledge, including audits, crawling and on-page optimisation.
- Experience using Google Search Console, GA4 and Semrush.
- Experience creating SEO strategies and turning data into clear actions.
- Knowledge of Local SEO, including Google Business Profiles and citations.
- An understanding of AI search, GEO or LLM visibility.
- Experience working with content teams and developers or SEO implementers.
- Experience reviewing SEO work and maintaining quality standards.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to explain SEO clearly to clients and colleagues.

What you'll get in return for your experience
You'll receive a £40,000 base salary plus a performance bonus of up to £5,000, giving you £45,000 OTE. The role is fully remote anywhere in the UK, with the flexibility and autonomy that comes with working in a growing business.

More importantly, you'll have genuine ownership of SEO. There's no senior SEO layer above you, so you'll have the opportunity to shape the function, influence how the team works and see the impact of your ideas.

What's next?
If this sounds like the right next step, apply via the button or get in touch with the consultant managing the role if you'd like to have an informal conversation about the opportunity.
